summary: Backend: 12/12 pytest pass, including a new check that /api/notes/reset returns fixed timestamps (2026-01-15 09:30 UTC, then each 5h earlier, same on every reset). Frontend tested at 375x667 via Playwright. Launch links work: ?mode=good goes to /demo/login with a GOOD badge, bugs=offline,timezone gives BROKEN ×2, bugs=all gives BROKEN ×9. The bug picker has 9 toggles, toggle-all works and the counter reads 0/9, 2/9, 9/9. Timezone: good mode shows device-local time (browser is UTC, so Jan 15, 09:30). The bug shows +14h (Jan 15, 23:30) on rows and in editor-created-time. GOOD offline works: banner with pending count, cached list kept, create/toggle/delete/edit are queued with note-pending tags, and going back online syncs everything (checked with GET /api/notes) and clears the tags. The queue also flushes after a page reload. BROKEN offline works: no banner, notes-empty shown, an offline save returns to the list as if saved, and the note never reaches the server. BROKEN layout works: header title overflows, network-toggle and badge go off-screen (x=448/504), delete buttons at x=588, FAB overlaps the rows, editor save button at x=136 and 640 wide. Good layout is fine. BROKEN memory duplicates rows, but the growth (8→24→48→80) does not match the spec (8→16→24). It also grows on a network toggle with no navigation. Good mode stays at 8. Regression of forms, buttons, crash, rotation, slow, good validation and offline login: all OK. Deprecated packages: none detected.

integration_issues.issue: Rows grow 8 -> 24 -> 48 -> 80 (quadratic), not 8 -> 16 -> 24 as specified. Cause: each focus pushes a new listener into the global leakedListeners, and every load calls ALL listeners, each appending the full list, so visit n adds n*8 rows. Reference: /app/frontend/app/demo/notes.tsx:54,74

useFocusEffect depends on load, which depends on cacheNotes/getCachedNotes. These are new functions each time the OfflineProvider value memo recomputes (isOffline/outbox/syncVersion). So toggling the network, enqueueing or syncing re-runs the focus effect. In broken memory mode this pushes another leaked listener and duplicates the list with no navigation (24 -> 40 on one offline/online toggle). In good mode it causes extra GET /api/notes. The offline banner/empty-list switch relies on this implicit re-run. Reference: /app/frontend/src/offline.tsx:126-127, /app/frontend/app/demo/notes.tsx:67-79

Mode and bug selection live only in React state (BugProvider useState). A page reload on /demo/* silently falls back to GOOD mode. An external replay that reloads mid-journey would lose the broken config. leakedListeners are also module-global and never reset on login or mode change, so in-app re-runs (no full reload) are not deterministic. Reference: /app/frontend/src/bug-config.tsx:47-48,86

issues: toggle-all-bugs is 91x36, below the 44pt minimum touch height

action_items: Fix the memory-leak growth to be linear (8->16->24) if that is the intended spec. For example, in leaky mode do a single setNotes(prev => [...prev, ...shown]) per load, and keep pushing listeners/heap only as the 'leak' (do not invoke every accumulated listener).

Wrap cacheNotes/getCachedNotes in useCallback (stable identity). Add an explicit useEffect on isOffline in notes.tsx to reload, so network toggles do not re-run the focus effect and push extra leaked listeners.
Optional: persist mode and bugs (storage or URL) so a reload keeps broken mode, and clear leakedListeners/leakedHeap on login so replays are deterministic.
Optional: raise toggle-all-bugs to at least 44pt height.
critical_code_review_comments: offline.tsx:64 calls setApiOffline(isOffline) during render (side effect in render). It works, but a useEffect or ref sync is cleaner.
The timezone bug is undetectable on devices that are already at UTC+14 (e.g. Pacific/Kiritimati), because good and broken render the same. This is an acceptable edge case.
Offline delete of a local (unsynced) note still replays create and then delete on sync, instead of dropping both ops. The result is correct but costs extra API calls.
Sync flush stops on the first error and only retries on the next outbox.length/isOffline change. There is no backoff or retry timer.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all features work. The memory-leak growth pattern deviates from the spec)

seed_data_creation: None. Login resets server notes to the 8-note seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env before pytest. In Playwright use page.request (not urllib, which gets 403) to GET /api/notes. Wait about 1s after screens mount before tapping. Browser TZ is UTC, so good times are 09:30, 04:30... and the broken timezone bug adds 14h. Launch link: /?mode=broken&bugs=a,b or bugs=all. Opening a done task with the crash bug on throws by design.
